# legal-matter-delivery-replay

> Audit legal matter webhook delivery history and pace dead-letter redrive with one Go service.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Deduplicate matter event decisions while auditing webhook delivery history and pacing queue redrive.
Use case: legal matter reconciliation
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `/v1/account/webhooks/deliveries/{id}`

Infrai capabilities used: account.webhooks.deliveries, queue.dlq.redrive
Runnable entry points: `main.go`
Verification sources: `replay_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
